content.test_md_blob:
# Place an order totaling exactly $25,000 directly without approval

> Prove that the spending rule is strict: an order at exactly $25,000 does not require approval and does not enter the approval path.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a browser, sign in to the NovaTech Business Store as a Buyer with {{buyer_login}} and {{buyer_password}}, and open the prepared quote {{exact_limit_quote_locator}} so its order review page is displayed.

## Step 2 @verifies ac-25

On the order review page for {{exact_limit_quote_locator}}, in the payment method section ensure Purchase Order is selected and enter {{valid_po_number}} if needed, then store the current review state as baseline_direct_place_review and assert the displayed order total including tax and delivery equals $25,000 and the primary action reads "Place Order".

## Step 3 @verifies ac-25

From that review state, place the order, then assert the flow goes directly to the order confirmation page without any approval-request step and the confirmation shows an order number beginning with NT-.
